description: Drag on the peer like a human: mouse down at from_x/from_y, move in steps to to_x/to_y, then release. Useful for sliders, selections, window moves, and drag/drop within the remote screen.

button.description: Mouse button to hold during the drag.

duration_ms.description: Approximate drag duration in milliseconds, clamped 0-10000.

from_screenshot.description: Set true when the start and end points were read from the last jrd_remote_screenshot picture. They are scaled to the remote screen for you.

steps.description: Number of intermediate move events, clamped 1-100.

name: jrd_mouse_drag
